summary.goal: Implement MCP tools for AI agents to interact with Planner
summary.context: Tools enable AI agents to: read plans, add/edit steps, infer dependencies, add acceptance criteria, submit for review. This is how AI becomes a planning partner.

acceptance_criteria.description: read_plan tool returns plan with current version
create_plan tool creates new plan from goal
add_step tool adds step to draft version
infer_dependencies tool analyzes steps and suggests dependencies
add_criteria tool adds acceptance criteria to step
submit_plan tool marks plan as submitted for review
All tools return structured responses suitable for AI consumption

steps.title: Set up MCP server infrastructure
steps.description: Create src/mcp/ directory with MCP server setup using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tools can be registered with server

steps.title: Create tool response schema
steps.description: Define consistent response format for all tools: success/error, data, message.

acceptance_criteria.description: ToolResponse type defined: { success, data?, error? }

steps.title: Implement read_plan tool
steps.description: Create tool to read plan with current version. Input: plan_id. Output: full plan with version and steps.

acceptance_criteria.description: Includes all steps with full details
Returns error if plan not found

steps.title: Implement create_plan tool
steps.description: Create tool to create new plan. Input: goal, context?. Output: created plan with draft version.

steps.title: Implement add_step tool
steps.description: Create tool to add step to draft version. Input: plan_id, title, scope?, description?, dependencies[].

acceptance_criteria.description: Adds step to latest draft version
Returns error if version is not draft
Returns updated version with new step

steps.title: Implement edit_step tool
steps.description: Create tool to modify existing step. Input: plan_id, step_id, changes object.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns error if step not found
Returns error if version is not draft

steps.title: Implement remove_step tool
steps.description: Create tool to remove step from plan. Input: plan_id, step_id.

acceptance_criteria.description: Removes step_id from other steps' dependencies
Returns error if step not found
Returns error if version is not draft

steps.title: Implement set_dependencies tool
steps.description: Create tool to set dependencies for a step. Input: plan_id, step_id, dependencies[].

acceptance_criteria.description: Validates no cycles would be created

steps.title: Implement add_criteria tool
steps.description: Create tool to add acceptance criterion to step. Input: plan_id, step_id, description, type?.

acceptance_criteria.description: Adds criterion to step's acceptance_criteria array
Returns updated step with new criterion

steps.title: Implement add_gate tool
steps.description: Create tool to add human approval gate to step. Input: plan_id, step_id, approver_role?.

steps.title: Implement submit_plan tool
steps.description: Create tool to submit plan for review. Input: plan_id.

acceptance_criteria.description: Marks latest draft version as submitted
Returns error if no draft version

steps.title: Implement list_plans tool
steps.description: Create tool to list plans. Input: status? filter. Output: array of plan summaries.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns plan_id, goal, status for each

steps.title: Add tool documentation
steps.description: Add comprehensive descriptions to all tools for AI consumption.

steps.title: Add unit tests for MCP tools
steps.description: Write tests for all MCP tools using mock storage.
